name: cycle_id
description: Unique identifier for the prediction cycle

name: run_id
description: GitHub Actions run_id or workstation execution ID

name: git_sha
description: Exact Git commit SHA of the running engine

name: sink
description: Destination table or sink name (e.g. option_predictions_live, market_news_sentiment)

name: status
description: Lifecycle state: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, NOT_DUE

name: records_count
description: Number of rows written to the sink in this cycle

name: error_message
description: Error diagnostic details if status is FAILED

name: created_at
description: Timezone-aware timestamp when this status record was created
